nativeValidation.reason: Desktop launch and UI acceptance require a real Antigravity 2.0 Desktop session.

manualAcceptanceChecklist.command: Desktop: launch Antigravity 2.0 and open a disposable project containing .agents/plugins/all-about-agents/plugin.json.
manualAcceptanceChecklist.expected: The package is discoverable from the workspace without automatic installation or a generated settings file.

manualAcceptanceChecklist.command: Desktop: inspect the discovered plugin and verify all skills, rules, hooks.json, and plugin.json are visible.
manualAcceptanceChecklist.expected: Documented plugin components are loaded; the agent layout caveat is shown for agents/.

manualAcceptanceChecklist.command: Desktop: invoke each role from a disposable project and inspect the available tools before any action.
manualAcceptanceChecklist.expected: Read-only architect, verifier, reviewer, and security-reviewer roles do not expose run_command; implementer retains only its documented command workflow.

manualAcceptanceChecklist.command: Desktop: open the conversation model selector, choose Gemini 3.7 Flash Medium, and start a second user message.
manualAcceptanceChecklist.expected: Medium is selectable and remains sticky only within that conversation; Gemini 3.7 Flash High is not offered and no cross-session persistence is claimed.

manualAcceptanceChecklist.command: Desktop: review the project security preset and manually exercise the documented Deny rules for command(rm -rf), command(sudo), write_file(.git/), and write_file(/home/user/.ssh).
manualAcceptanceChecklist.expected: Deny > Ask > Allow is shown and each emergency rule blocks the matching request.

manualAcceptanceChecklist.command: Desktop: inspect hooks.json and, only with an explicitly approved local handler, verify each documented hook decision in a disposable project.
manualAcceptanceChecklist.expected: The packaged hook contract remains disabled and inert; no command handler is auto-installed or executed.
